newsitem.title: FRANCE: TENNIS-RAIN HALTS PLAY AT FRENCH OPEN.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-RAIN HALTS PLAY AT FRENCH OPEN.

text.p: Play at the French Open was interrupted by rain for the first time in the tournament on Monday, allowing Chilean seventh seed Marcelo Rios some much-needed breathing space.
Rios was trailing Morocco's Hicham Arazi by two sets to one when the weather halted play with the pair level at 2-2 in the fourth set of their fourth round match.
The other remaining men's singles encounter between Australians Pat Rafter and Mark Woodforde was also in a fourth set, with Rafter leading 6-2 5-7 6-1 3-1 when the rain began.
